derivedFacts.statement: True when lifecycle is PAID or CANCELLED.

dimensions.purpose: Represent exactly one order lifecycle state.
dimensions.terminalOrReset: PAID and CANCELLED are terminal; FAILED may be retried under policy.

dimensions.purpose: Represent provider connectivity independently of order lifecycle.

duplicateStateProhibitions: UI and adapter caches may not become independently mutable lifecycle authorities.

observations.freshnessPolicy: Captured once per command and passed explicitly.

canonicalState.persistenceBoundary: Order state and pending effect intent commit atomically before provider execution.
canonicalState.versionFenceSemantics: Every result carries order revision and attempt fence; stale results are rejected.

contextHandling.externalData: Provider result passed as typed input.

decisionBoundaries.freshnessValidation: Expected revision and attempt fence must match.
decisionBoundaries.hiddenDependencyPolicy: No global clock, random source, database or network access.

delegatedFreedom: Private helper decomposition and internal naming may vary.

effectContracts.ambiguousAcknowledgement: Enter reconciliation; do not create a new attempt until provider status is known.
effectContracts.cancellationSemantics: Cancellation before provider acceptance prevents execution; after acceptance it becomes a compensating workflow.
effectContracts.compensationPolicy: Issue a separate refund command when authorized; never roll back history.
effectContracts.duplicateBehavior: Return the existing provider result or pending status without repeating charge.
effectContracts.durableAfterInterruption: Pending intent and attempt fence remain durable.
externalRestrictions: No real provider use in fixtures.
effectContracts.intent: Authorize payment for one order attempt.
effectContracts.orderingRequirements: One active payment attempt per order revision.
effectContracts.partialCompletion: Provider may accept while acknowledgement is lost.
preconditions: Order is AUTHORIZING with matching attempt.
effectContracts.resultReceipt: Typed PaymentResult with provider reference and attempt ID.
effectContracts.retryPolicy: Retry only when the previous attempt is proven not accepted or the same key is safe.
effectContracts.timeoutMeaning: Unknown outcome until reconciled by idempotency key.

formalization.divergenceHandling: Any mapping or property divergence creates a material structure finding.
exploredBounds: up to 8 commands per generated trace
limitations: Does not model provider internal failure.
formalization.rationale: Retries, duplicates and ambiguous acknowledgement require sequence exploration.

invariants.statement: An order has exactly one lifecycle variant.
One idempotency key cannot authorize two provider effects.
PAID requires a validated receipt for the active attempt.

rationale: Order processing crosses a persistence and provider boundary with retries and ambiguous acknowledgement.

acceptanceCriteria: Effect intent, execution, receipt and semantic commit remain distinct.

title: Order processing state and effects

transitionRules.rejection: Reject when offline, stale, unauthorized or already terminal.
